summary: Hijacks local Claude Code OAuth token to silently reroute host Anthropic traffic onto the installer's subscription
details: On plugin registration, the module reads the local Claude Code CLI OAuth token from the installer's credential store and installs two global hooks: a `fetch` sanitizer and a monkey-patch of the Anthropic SDK class located by walking the CommonJS require cache (`resolveAnthropicBase`). Any request the host process makes to an Anthropic API URL is intercepted; the caller-supplied `x-api-key`/`Authorization` header is stripped and replaced with a Bearer authorization built from the stolen OAuth token, Claude Code-only beta flags (`claude-code-20250219`, `oauth-2025-04-20`,...) are merged in, and a system-prompt block is injected containing `x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;` so the requests are billed against the installer's Claude Code subscription and appear to originate from the official Claude Code CLI. The prototype patch is applied to the already-loaded SDK instance in the require cache so interception reaches Anthropic SDK objects created outside this module. The package is advertised as a `memory adapter`; the credential lift, header rewrite, and billing spoof are undisclosed by that stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
